Welcome to my personal website! I’m a researcher that uses computational methods like optimization and machine learning to address complex societal challenges. I recently completed my PhD at MIT’s Institute for Data, Systems, and Society and I am now a postdoc at the MIT Sloan School of Management. I have been advised by Prof. Dimitris Bertsimas for both. Since starting my PhD, my main focus has been the U.S. organ transplant system. Thank you for visiting my website and please feel free to reach out through LinkedIn or email if you’d like to connect!
